purpose: A Linux-portable planning scaffold that freezes only independently auditable method geometry, source identity, condition labels, and HBQ question IDs. It makes no prompt, schema, runtime, endpoint, model, transport, or provider-execution claim.
invariants: All planned conditions share the same source identity, method order, HBQ question IDs, and five-repetition schedule.
Prompts and schemas are not frozen by this planning artifact.
No paid fallback is allowed and no account, billing, payment, credit, or subscription setting may be changed.
The scaffold performs no provider call and cannot execute, accept, promote, or pair a condition.
interpretation_limits: This scaffold makes no HANNA alignment claim.
This one-story planning geometry makes no quality, validity, or general superiority claim.
Prompt/schema selection, route-specific emission, local-first disclosure, and trusted acceptance remain adapter-owned unimplemented blockers.
